purpose: Left-side scale-in rule (the one owner). Read by the brief packet, both add-side reads and `evaluate-add-shapes --campaigns`. Kept out of add-alpha-policy.json on purpose: that file's hash is the exploration campaign id, so editing it would reset every one-tranche-per-policy exploration count.

left_side.mode_rationale: kcn 2026-09-27: 左侧要进策略（「不可能只有单边右侧交易是好的」）。形态：observe = 两入口出左侧读数与档位、packet 记录闸门状态并逐日留痕到 assets/data/left_side_history.jsonl，不给尺寸、不进 technical.setups、不授权下单。依据（run card add_campaigns-20260927-12aa143a 的 families，非杠杆 OOS：每单位投入 0.64% vs 基准 1.70%；以下 left_vs_right 数字晚于该卡、不在卡内，见 harness.md 脚注 ²）：左侧与右侧日 P&L 相关 0.57、对右侧 beta 0.78、年化 alpha -0.72% book/单位，Sharpe 门槛 0.62 > 左侧 0.42，任何权重并入右侧都降低风险调整收益；合体 CI 下界转正是样本合并效应，不是分散化。唯一未测的 edge 来源是 thesis/资讯/同业闸，只能前瞻测。改成 authorize 与尺寸数值是 kcn 拍板项，见 docs/architecture/harness.md § Add-side strategy。
left_side.rationale: Terms as registered in #2001; not re-fitted for this decision. 27 eligible Tencent names, IS < 2025-07-01 <= OOS. Non-leveraged OOS: 141 campaigns, mean 2.18%, 90% month-block interval -0.17% to 5.08%; per deployed unit 0.64% vs always-in baseline 1.70%. Five three-month walk-forward folds: mean 7.89/-0.80/-4.10/6.10/0.86%. Per rung (unit return to exit) IS 3.6/3.9/0.19%, OOS 1.56/0.23/-0.69%: the third rung is the weakest in both halves. Leveraged: negative in both halves, excluded. Without the MA200 permission OOS drawdown -14.93% of book: rejected.
